description: Solar Site Overview is a dataset listed in Town of Morrisville Open Data, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a city, published or maintained by Town of Morrisville; Solar Edge. This data is pulled from our various solar projects throughout town. All information is pulled and updated in real time multiple times during the day. As new solar projects come online across the Town, we will add their production amounts to this as well. Coverage: Morrisville, North Carolina. The portal files it under Environment. Its keywords are solar, solar edge, power, renewable, energy, sustainability. The portal shows 4 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-opendata-townofmorrisville-org-portal.
